g.text: Urban Balochistan earnings rise until the late 20s, plateau into the 40s, then edge up;
the highest band mean (60-64) rests on only 16 earners
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person file. Sample: earners aged 15-64, Balochistan urban (n = 486). Weighted by hhweight.
Red markers: weighted mean earnings by 5-year age band, plotted at band midpoint; hollow markers: fewer than 30 earners in the band.
